system.name: Personal Finance Advisor Expert System
system.description: A rule-based expert system for assessing financial health and generating personalized financial recommendations.

reduce_debt.title: Reduce Debt
reduce_debt.summary: Prioritize reducing your monthly debt obligations.
reduce_debt.explanation: High debt repayments reduce your ability to save, invest, and respond to financial emergencies.
reduce_debt.benefit: Reducing debt improves financial flexibility and increases long-term financial stability.

build_emergency_fund.title: Build an Emergency Fund
build_emergency_fund.summary: Increase your emergency savings before pursuing major investments.
build_emergency_fund.explanation: Emergency savings protect you against unexpected financial events such as job loss or medical emergencies.
build_emergency_fund.benefit: A healthy emergency fund reduces financial stress and prevents unnecessary borrowing.

improve_budget.title: Improve Budgeting
improve_budget.summary: Review your monthly spending and align it with your income.
improve_budget.explanation: Effective budgeting helps ensure that essential expenses, savings, and investments remain balanced.
improve_budget.benefit: Improved budgeting creates opportunities for saving and achieving long-term financial goals.

start_investing.title: Begin Investing
start_investing.summary: Consider starting a long-term investment plan.
start_investing.explanation: Your financial situation indicates readiness to begin building long-term wealth through investing.
start_investing.benefit: Consistent investing can help grow your wealth and support future financial goals.

maintain_financial_health.title: Maintain Your Financial Health
maintain_financial_health.summary: Continue following your current financial habits.
maintain_financial_health.explanation: Your financial profile demonstrates healthy budgeting, manageable debt, and good financial preparedness.
maintain_financial_health.benefit: Maintaining these habits supports long-term financial security.

increase_savings.title: Increase Monthly Savings
increase_savings.summary: Allocate a larger portion of your income toward savings.
increase_savings.explanation: Regular saving strengthens financial resilience and supports future financial objectives.
increase_savings.benefit: Higher savings improve your ability to manage emergencies and invest in future opportunities.

reduce_debt.title: Debt Reduction Plan
reduce_debt.objective: Lower your monthly debt burden and improve financial flexibility.
steps: Pay high-interest debt before lower-interest debt.
Avoid taking on new unnecessary debt.
Use any additional income to make extra debt repayments.
Review your debt-to-income ratio every month.

build_emergency_fund.title: Emergency Savings Plan
build_emergency_fund.objective: Build sufficient savings to cover unexpected financial emergencies.
steps: Keep emergency savings in an easily accessible account.
Aim to save at least three to six months of essential expenses.
Avoid using emergency savings for non-emergency spending.

improve_budget.title: Budget Improvement Plan
improve_budget.objective: Improve spending habits and increase financial stability.
steps: Review your budget at the end of each month.

increase_savings.title: Savings Growth Plan
increase_savings.objective: Increase the amount of money saved each month.

start_investing.title: Investment Readiness Plan
start_investing.objective: Begin building long-term wealth through appropriate investments.
steps: Choose investments that match your risk profile.
